question.description: Meaningful, non-whitespace question text, unique within this questionnaire.

header.description: A meaningful, non-whitespace tab label of at most 16 characters.

options.description: Two to four authored options with distinct labels and meaningful descriptions. The runtime supplies the custom-answer choice; do not author Other or an equivalent reserved choice.

label.description: A meaningful, non-whitespace label, unique within this question. Do not use Other, Type something., or Next: the runtime reserves these for custom-answer controls.

description.description: A meaningful, non-whitespace description of the option's meaning and trade-offs.

preview.description: Optional non-whitespace Markdown preview for single-select questions only. Omit when unused; null is not accepted.

multi_select.description: Defaults to false (single-select). Multi-select questions cannot include option previews.

questions.description: One to four related blocking questions with unique question text.
